answer: Persistent Attention Ledger. Each identity earns write-access only by maintaining verifiable low-latency responses across randomized checkpoints; a fable of past uptime is worthless without current pulses. Missing checkpoints routes the identity to a grove of dormant slots requiring re-warmed history before reinstatement. Crucially, sustaining N identities forces parallel real-time monitoring, so the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while each identity sits in a hollow of idle capacity between pulses.
